phase_name: user_decision relay, commit, multi-state update, lock release, output (WORK e, i, j)

objectives.description: user_decision relay: verdict=ask_user, payload relayed verbatim, status left as agent reported it
Per-task scoped commit via git-commit-scoped.sh with --honest-index-rows and modified_files staging
Commit-message selection keyed off dispatch_status and implemented_gate_passed
Non-blocking commit failure, lock release never withheld
Multi-state update (current_statuses/completed_tasks/failed_tasks/cycle_modified_files), scoped to multi-task engine only
Unconditional per-task lock release, scoped to multi-task engine only
Assemble final compact JSON line with resolved verdict (ok|defer|blocked|failed|ask_user)
Honour --dry-run across every mutating call site added in Phases 2-5 (retroactive gating)
objectives.note: Required touching Phase 2-4 code too, since --dry-run's 'zero side effects' contract spans the whole script, not just Phase 5's own additions. One KNOWN, DELIBERATE exception recorded in is_live()'s header: skill_gate_completion_claim's own internal non-fatal system-defect-record.sh call in its Case 3/3 refuse branch is not gated, since skipping the call would also lose the allow/refuse decision the output needs.

approaches_tried.reason: Bash parameter-expansion default-word matching stops at the FIRST unescaped '}', so "${recover_json:-{}}"  silently appends a stray trailing '}' to any non-empty recover_json, corrupting the JSON. jq's -r mode still printed the correct value to stdout before hitting the trailing garbage, but its own exit code 5 (parse error) triggered the || fallback, silently overwriting the correct value with the literal string 'unknown'. This is the exact landmine skill_orchestrate_propagate_completion's own header comment in skill-base.sh already documents for a different variable (completion_json) -- caught here by hand-testing the user_decision relay against a 'partial'-status fixture before Phase 6's fixture suite would have. Fixed via the documented safe pattern: `var="$x"; [ -z "$var" ] && var='{}'`.
